baseline.label_note: Label names are NOT documented in the dataset card; they were inferred from canonical-motif enrichment on the training split. The evidence is strong: 98.5% of label-2 rows carry GT (or its reverse complement AC) at one fixed offset, 99.8% of label-1 rows carry AG (or CT), versus at most 13.6% of label-0 rows.

single_offset_rule.description: dinucleotide at offset k: GT -> donor, AG -> acceptor, else none; every offset scanned

strand_aware_rule.description: donor if GT@k_GT or AC@k_AC (reverse complement); acceptor if AG@k_AG or CT@k_CT; donor wins if both; else none

variant_selection.protocol: selection split = 10% of the training rows, class-stratified, seed 42; selection heads trained on the other rows with the 03 MLP recipe (own early-stopping split inside); variant chosen by selection-split accuracy; final number = that variant's 03 test score (head refit on all training rows)

variant_selection_hardneg.protocol: selection split = the 10% original training rows of variant_selection (class-stratified, seed 42) + whole hard-negative genes (seeded, ~10% of the training-split hard negatives); two selection heads per variant (without / with hard negatives) on the remaining rows, 03 MLP recipe; variant chosen by the hard-negative head's accuracy on the whole selection split; final number = that variant's 03 --hardneg test score
